title: Settings dialog at 360x740 is one column: every section fits, Sign out does not cover its words, Connect account is whole
steps: S1: Run packages/ui/tracy-settings/test/e2e/settings-fits-360.test.mjs (the real SettingsPage with the real General, Account, AI accounts, Notifications and Help & about sections and each plugin's stylesheet, at 360x740 light and dark, and at 1280x800).
expect: S1: at 360x740 the section (.ts-content) is as wide as the dialog (.ts-surface) less its border, nothing in it sticks out sideways, the page does not scroll sideways, in every section, light and dark.
S1: Settings > Account: no line of the Session row's words lies under the Sign out button.
S1: Settings > AI accounts: both Connect account buttons lie inside the section and show their whole label.
S1: the open section's tab is in view; every section is reachable from the strip.
S1: at 1280x800 the nav stays 196px beside the section in a 760px dialog.
evidence: Measured on dev 09/10/2026 at 360x740 (account-menu acceptance hc-hca-360-*-9-account.jpg, -9-ai-accounts.jpg): the 196px nav beside the section left it about 100px; Sign out covered its help line and Connect account was cut off
fence: Responsive rules of the Settings dialog (packages/ui/tracy-settings/src/client/styles.ts, max-width 640px) and the wrapping rows of Account (tracy-my-sites styles.ts) and AI accounts (tracy-model-plan AccountSubscription)

tests: at 360x740: the dialog is one column
at 360x740, dark: the dialog is one column
at 1280x800 the dialog keeps its two columns
